historical_cutoff: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 10 (2026-11-16); no Week 11 games included

source_snapshot.sportsbook: DraftKings (user-approved fallback; no FanDuel rows for this event)

main_line_selection_method: For each player/market, selected the available DraftKings over line whose listed American odds are numerically closest to -110; exact line and odds preserved.
qualification_rule: Market HR >=6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >=8/10. Comparisons use strictly greater-than for threshold lines.
